plans.idea: Left-to-right banner read: small Quillbrook seal, then the tin as a full-height anchor, then a roomy two-line headline block, ending in a right-hand action column with NEW HARVEST stacked over the button so the CTA no longer crowds the headline.

Mirrors the original: the brand seal sits above a wide text block on the left, a badge-over-CTA column bridges to the tin anchored full-height on the right, so the copy leads and the product closes the read.

Three-column symmetry with the tin as the centre: the seal and headline copy on the left, the product in the middle, and a large CTA with its badge on the right, so the eye goes headline, then product, then action.
